NativeSqlValue.description: SQLite scalar. Use {integer: decimal-string} for exact signed 64-bit values outside JavaScript's safe range and {blob: hex-string} for binary values. Arbitrary objects and arrays are rejected as SQL parameters.

value.description: Empty bytes are null, UTF-8 bytes are a string, other bytes are hex encoded.

amount.description: Integer atomic units as a decimal string. USDC has six atomic decimals. Parse without floating-point conversion.

nativeBearer.description: Configured native read/write token in non-payment mode. Reads use the read token when configured, otherwise the write token; writes require the write token. If no token is configured, the corresponding native operation is open.

operatorBearer.description: Existing operator credential, required by retained native Durable Objects and wallet issuance when payment mode is enabled. This does not make those operations available to ordinary paid clients.

paymentVoucher.description: Encoded x402 signed cumulative wallet voucher. Amounts are integer token atoms and the signed payTo binds the recipient. Preserve signed serialization and reconcile cumulative spending after unknown outcomes.
paymentVoucher.name: payment-signature

walletBearer.description: Legacy router wallet token, scoped to that wallet. Not a CLI, website, project or S3 credential.

info.description: Native HTTP contracts, including retained legacy interfaces. Public S3 uses a separate wire specification. Availability and authentication depend on router configuration; documentation URLs are not API base URLs.
